title: Anthropic roadmap: infinite context and long-horizon reasoning
summary: Anthropic outlined three focus areas for its next-generation models: higher engineering judgment and code taste, an effectively infinite context window, and multi-agent coordination with persistent long-horizon reasoning. No release date or model name was confirmed.

research.notes: Forward-looking roadmap statements. The 'Mythos architecture' and 'Claude 5' framing is speculative.
